rounds.notes:
R1 is classic roleq Dva but you can apply those tips for any round up to R7. Actually you need to scale for being a lobby admin and more you got item and scale money more you can be arrogant :

***This are ALL THE THINGS YOU NEED TO DO INGAME  to be the best Lobby admin Dva. There is no secret just try again and again and learn what the best for you in any situation. i'll give you all the tools and tips for specific situation NOW ITS YOUR TURN !***


- Play main and face enemy Tank shoot him and [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) him aswell for Cut the heal if possible vs like Enemy [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18) Etc. Basically any support you can eat healing with [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) and also make him losing space for your team. You need at this moment to already think about your next action ( Don't worry everything you need is write below )

- Abuse High ground with DVA as much as possible since [Boosters](ability_f8b09a55-efe2-4f1f-8abe-9a31fca0f541) cooldowns are very short, if you can make everyone in enemy team watching at you and stay alive you can just having infinite value, taking a lot of space for your whole team and it's also mix very well abusing high ground with [Focused Fusion](item_1123c91f-7348-4e50-aa1c-4a9961650f40) POWER since you have way more range to hit.

- Wait for an opportunity to punish an enemy out of position in your backline or in their backline, the most important thing to know is to measure RISK/REWARD means it's better to go in with [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) atleast in 50% charge and [Micro Missiles](ability_706d5186-2b4a-4813-97d6-c36864cc3491) UP because you need ressources to dive. The key is to ALWAYS stay alive no matter what ! 

- Protect your backline. YOU CAN DO EVERYTHING AS DVA vs match up Like Monkey/Genji even a Reinhardt who charge your backline , The key is to understand as Dva if you can trade their backline and kill them faster than the enemy team or you can just back and help your team and also punish the enemy in. You cannot complain about everyone is dying vs dive if you don't help them.

***You litterally need to always doing anything when you are full HP and full cooldowns, SHOOT AND MAKE DAMAGE ON TANK, PROTECT THE TEAM, DIVE THE SUPPORT AND DPS, TAKE SPACE CREATE CHAOS MAKE EVERY ENEMY LOOKING AT YOU AND STAY ALIVE. You can't be passive as DVA.***

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

VS BEAM only : Against [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0) or Multiple beam in one match like : [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) + [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0) + [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) . I do not recommand to use Beam item against a single [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88). Not really a big threat compared to [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0) burst.

In term of power you have 3 options for the round 1 :

1. Take [Facetanking](item_f8af63d1-1fd4-4758-86ce-96f1ef7ea1ea) Because you play for exemple against [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0) or 2 beam maximum and you still can absorb damage from hitscan like [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b) or [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54) substain HP and play around them.

2. Take [Stat Boost](item_d3ef725b-3183-417c-bc5a-76bfa21c6cc5) because you have nothing to [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) like vs 3 beam for exemple + [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) means a lot of counter and you want be ready in R2 with [Plot Armor](item_d1427316-79d1-43a7-a608-67beb1595131) and extended [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) to still survive against beam.

3. Take [Focused Fusion](item_1123c91f-7348-4e50-aa1c-4a9961650f40) vs also 3 beam for exemple etc because you feel extremely confident in your aim + timing taking high ground and be annoying  so you  could probably scale faster until R3 but i need to warn this is really technical playstyle especially vs lot of beam but HIGH EFFORT HIGH VALUE.


Take [Refraction Armor](item_dd020802-8d00-489d-93e0-930b80e31144) + [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) Round 1 if you want play defensive.

If you want mix agressive playstyle with [Focused Fusion](item_1123c91f-7348-4e50-aa1c-4a9961650f40) take [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) + [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) + [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) instead

All of this is about what work the best for you , some dva player are pretty agressive some aren't so i'll give you all the possible options !

Keep playing as i told you on the first Round 1 notes , you're almost the lobby admin at this point.

***Don't forget to read Optional items notes to understand each way to play !***

For me if you have enough money [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) + [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) + [Wrist Wraps](item_19183386-c859-42ca-93f2-355d47d01e36) is just the best combo.

VS BEAM only : Against [Zarya](hero_be6cc516-0b7a-4515-8472-f489f08993b0) or Multiple beam in one match like : [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed) + [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0) + [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) : 

- Take [Plot Armor](item_d1427316-79d1-43a7-a608-67beb1595131) and you can go for [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) + [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) item and if you have enough money go for [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) or [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054)

Item are pretty the same if you decide to take [Focused Fusion](item_1123c91f-7348-4e50-aa1c-4a9961650f40) or [Facetanking](item_f8af63d1-1fd4-4758-86ce-96f1ef7ea1ea) or [Stat Boost](item_d3ef725b-3183-417c-bc5a-76bfa21c6cc5) round 1. I do not recommand to build more defensive blue item since you already lack of damage because [Plot Armor](item_d1427316-79d1-43a7-a608-67beb1595131) R2 and just follow now classic agressive build and play around your early power as i told you Round 1, it will help you find your own early game playstyle.

[Three-Tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429)  give you a lot of bonus damage after using [Boosters](ability_f8b09a55-efe2-4f1f-8abe-9a31fca0f541) and [Micro Missiles](ability_706d5186-2b4a-4813-97d6-c36864cc3491) against any target especially TANK. You can burst a lot with it and confirm some target.

[Weapon Jammer](item_72386db6-753e-413d-aa2a-f1389842f47f) is more regular in term of dps if you don't like playstyle around [Micro Missiles](ability_706d5186-2b4a-4813-97d6-c36864cc3491) dive and [Boosters](ability_f8b09a55-efe2-4f1f-8abe-9a31fca0f541). You need to abuse [Boosters](ability_f8b09a55-efe2-4f1f-8abe-9a31fca0f541) to getting back quick your [Defense Matrix](ability_88831f83-b0fd-434b-92f5-afdc1d809da2) since you can reduce damage by 65% on beam with it. Go for classic build now but you need keep Atleast [Plot Armor](item_d1427316-79d1-43a7-a608-67beb1595131) it's very important !
